features.title: Why ltth.app for your stream?
features.subtitle: Professional streaming features specifically designed for TikTok LIVE

card1.title: AnimazingPal Brain Engine 🧠
card1.desc: AI-powered memory and personality system for VTuber avatars with GPT-4o-mini / GPT-5 Nano, semantic vector search and 15+ API endpoints.

card2.title: Realtime TikTok LIVE Connection
card2.desc: Connect live with your TikTok stream. Receive gifts, comments, follows, shares, and likes in real-time with no delay. Auto-reconnect on connection loss.

card3.title: Text-to-Speech System
card3.desc: 75+ TikTok voices and 30+ Google Cloud voices. User-specific voice mapping, automatic TTS for chat, blacklist function and adjustable volume/speed settings.

card4.title: Customizable Alert System
card4.desc: Create custom alerts for all event types. Sound + Text + Image/GIF support, template system with variables and minimum coin filter for professional stream presentations.

card5.title: Soundboard with 100,000+ Sounds
card5.desc: Access to MyInstants database. Gift-specific sounds with icons, event sounds for follow/subscribe/share, like-threshold system and sound picker with search and favorites.

card6.title: Goals & Overlays
card6.desc: 4 separate goals (likes, followers, subs, coins) with individual browser source overlays. Customizable styles, colors, fonts and auto-modes on goal achievement for your OBS integration.

card7.title: Event Automation (Flows)
card7.desc: If-then automations without programming. 6 trigger types, 6 action types, complex conditions with 8 operators. Trigger TTS, alerts, sounds, webhooks and more.

card8.title: OBS Integration
card8.desc: Transparent full-HD overlay (1920x1080) for your streams. HUD configuration via drag & drop, separate goal overlays and full browser source compatibility.

card9.title: User Profile System
card9.desc: Multiple databases for different streaming setups. Profile switching, backup function and separate configurations for different stream formats.

card10.title: Slot Machine
card10.desc: Slot Machine, Wheel of Fortune, Plinko, Connect 4 and Chess – all driven by TikTok gifts. Token system, superfan detection, OBS overlay and 7 unique sounds.

card11.title: Weather Engine
card11.desc: 13 procedural weather effects including Aurora, Fireflies, Meteors, Sakura and WebGPU Emoji Rain. Adaptive FPS, GPU-optimized – live on your OBS stream.

card12.title: Music Bot
card12.desc: YouTube search via yt-dlp (no Python required), Spotify/SoundCloud oEmbed, vote-skip, 3 OBS overlay designs and superfan-only requests.

card13.title: Game Engine
card13.desc: Slot Machine, Wheel of Fortune, Quiz, Predictions and Token Games – fully integrated with TikTok events.

card14.title: VRChat OSC Integration
card14.desc: VRChat/OpenShock integration via OSC protocol – control avatars and hardware via TikTok events.

card15.title: Plugin System
card15.desc: Modular extension system with hot-loading. 30+ pre-installed plugins (TTS, Soundboard, Multi-Cam, OSC-Bridge, VDO.Ninja, Emoji Rain, Topboard). Create your own plugins with the plugin API.

card5.desc: Multi-guest streaming. Room management, guest management, layout control.

card6.title: Topboard Plugin
card6.desc: Top gifters, longest streaks, recent donors with real-time updates.

card7.title: Emoji Rain
card7.desc: Emoji rain effect on gifts. Gift-to-emoji mappings, animation speed/density.

card8.title: Custom
card8.desc: Create your own plugins with the plugin API. ZIP upload, hot-loading, admin UI.
